messages:
sara: Quick tiny poll — naming a mascot for our docs and swag. Pick one or add a write-in.

sara: Options:
• 1) Redwood Rudy 🌲
• 2) KV (the Kernel) 🧠
• 3) Sparky the Inference Fox 🦊
• 4) Write-in (reply below)

kevin: Rudy :thumbsup:
maya: KV is hilarious, vote KV
ana: Sparky is adorable, vote 3
dave: Write-in: "Byte the Squirrel" 🐿️ (can't help myself)
sophie: Putting an emoji vote for Rudy + Sparky :heart_eyes:
sara: cool — I'm counting votes. I'll leave open until EOD. @marketing if this wins would love some sticker mockups :pray:
kevin: Also, if KV wins, naming the next infra VM "Kernel Panic" is mandatory :joy:
poll-bot: Poll auto-close set for 1938460000 (EOD)
maya: if it's close, we should do a tiny T-shirt run
sara: Poll closed — results: Redwood Rudy 3, Sparky 2, KV (the Kernel) 1, Write-in 1
sara: Thanks everyone — I'll share follow-up design thread tomorrow :tada:
